name: PromptTokenizer

test_list.description: A tokenizer paired with the request's ChatModel counts the provider's complete chat template, enabled tool schemas, and supported reasoning replay fields and reports positive model context capacity.
A tokenizer or selected model that cannot provide an exact count returns ModelError rather than a byte- or text-length heuristic.
The reported input token count may exceed max_context_tokens so the caller can trim before sending; callers validate count and capacity against output reservations and policy.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The full request including message history, enabled tool schemas, model, effort, and reasoning replay metadata.

output_description: Exact tokenizer-derived input count plus the selected model's positive context capacity; no count is synthesized when tokenizer support is unavailable.
